cnv <- read.csv("CPTAC_PanCan_Arm_Level_CopyNumber_NORMALIZED.csv", check.names = FALSE)
colnames(cnv)[1] <- "Sample"

```{r}
# Helper function to load one xCell file 
load_xcell <- function(tumor_name, filename) {
  raw <- read.delim(filename, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
  df  <- as.data.frame(t(raw[,-1]))
  colnames(df)  <- raw$idx
  df$Sample     <- rownames(df)
  df$TumorType  <- tumor_name
  rownames(df)  <- NULL
  return(df)
}

# Load all tumor type xCel files 
xcell_all <- bind_rows(
  load_xcell("LUAD",  "xCell/LUAD_RNAseq_xCell_Tumor.cct"),
  load_xcell("HNSCC", "xCell/HNSCC_RNAseq_xCell_Tumor.cct"),
  #load_xcell("BLCA",  "xCell/BLCA_RNAseq_xCell_Tumor.cct"),
  load_xcell("PDA",  "xCell/PDA_RNAseq_xCell_Tumor.cct"),
  load_xcell("CO",  "xCell/CO_RNAseq_xCell_Tumor.cct"),
  #load_xcell("LGG",   "xCell/LGG_RNAseq_xCell_Tumor.cct"),
  #load_xcell("UVM",   "xCell/UVM_RNAseq_xCell_Tumor.cct"),
  load_xcell("BR",  "xCell/BR_RNAseq_xCell_Tumor.cct"),
  #load_xcell("LIHC",  "xCell/LIHC_RNAseq_xCell_Tumor.cct")
)
```

```{r}
# ─Check tumor type name alignment before merging ───────────────────
cat("CNV tumor types:", unique(cnv$TumorType), "\n")
cat("xCell tumor types:", unique(xcell_all$TumorType), "\n")
cat("Arm columns:", grep("^Arm_", colnames(cnv), value = TRUE), "\n")
```
```{r}
# Merge CNV + xCell 
merged_all <- left_join(cnv, xcell_all, by = c("Sample", "TumorType"))
cat("Merged rows:", nrow(merged_all), "\n")
cat("Merged tumor types:", unique(merged_all$TumorType), "\n")
```

```{r}
# xCell column name mapping
celltype_map <- c(
  "CD8+ T cells"       = "T cell CD8+",
  "NK cells"           = "NK cell",
  "M1 macrophages"     = "Macrophage M1",
  "M2 macrophages"     = "Macrophage M2",
  "Fibroblasts"        = "Cancer associated fibroblast",
  "Endothelial cells"  = "Endothelial cell"
)
```

# Tier 1 

```{r}
# Tier 1 targets — only available tumor types
# BLCA, LGG, UVM not available in CPTAC
targets <- tribble(
  ~TumorType, ~Arm,      ~CNV_type, ~CellType,
  # 9q loss
  "LUAD",     "Arm_9q",  "Loss",    "CD8+ T cells",
  "LUAD",     "Arm_9q",  "Loss",    "NK cells",
  "LUAD",     "Arm_9q",  "Loss",    "M1 macrophages",
  "PDA",      "Arm_9q",  "Loss",    "CD8+ T cells",
  "HNSCC",    "Arm_9q",  "Loss",    "Fibroblasts",
  # 18q loss
  "CO",       "Arm_18q", "Loss",    "CD8+ T cells",
  "CO",       "Arm_18q", "Loss",    "Fibroblasts",
  "HNSCC",    "Arm_18q", "Loss",    "CD8+ T cells",
  "HNSCC",    "Arm_18q", "Loss",    "Fibroblasts",
  "HNSCC",    "Arm_18q", "Loss",    "Endothelial cells",
  "PDA",      "Arm_18q", "Loss",    "CD8+ T cells",
  "PDA",      "Arm_18q", "Loss",    "M1 macrophages",
  "BR",       "Arm_18q", "Loss",    "Fibroblasts",
  "BR",       "Arm_18q", "Loss",    "M2 macrophages",
  # 1p loss
  "PDA",      "Arm_1p",  "Loss",    "M1 macrophages",
  "PDA",      "Arm_1p",  "Loss",    "Fibroblasts",
  "PDA",      "Arm_1p",  "Loss",    "Endothelial cells"
)

# Colors
cnv_colors_loss <- c("Loss" = "#4575b4", "Neutral" = "grey70")
cnv_colors_gain <- c("Gain" = "#D64045", "Neutral" = "grey70")
```

p-value determined by wilcox test 
2 sided by default 

```{r}
# Plot 
# dir.create("boxplots_tier1", showWarnings = FALSE)

for (i in 1:nrow(targets)) {
  tumor    <- targets$TumorType[i]
  arm_col  <- targets$Arm[i]
  cnvtype  <- targets$CNV_type[i]
  ct_label <- targets$CellType[i]
  ct_col   <- celltype_map[ct_label]
  arm_name <- gsub("Arm_", "", arm_col)

  # Filter to tumor type
  df_tumor <- merged_all %>% filter(TumorType == tumor)

  # Skip if arm or cell type column not found
  if (!arm_col %in% colnames(df_tumor)) {
    message(paste("Skipping — arm not found:", arm_col, "in", tumor)); next
  }
  if (!ct_col %in% colnames(df_tumor)) {
    message(paste("Skipping — cell type not found:", ct_col, "in", tumor)); next
  }

  # Classify CNV status
  if (cnvtype == "Loss") {
    df_tumor <- df_tumor %>%
      mutate(CNV_status = case_when(
        .data[[arm_col]] < -0.2 ~ "Loss",
        .data[[arm_col]] >= -0.2 & .data[[arm_col]] <= 0.2 ~ "Neutral",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )) %>%
      filter(CNV_status %in% c("Loss", "Neutral"))
    colors <- cnv_colors_loss
  } else {
    df_tumor <- df_tumor %>%
      mutate(CNV_status = case_when(
        .data[[arm_col]] > 0.2 ~ "Gain",
        .data[[arm_col]] >= -0.2 & .data[[arm_col]] <= 0.2 ~ "Neutral",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )) %>%
      filter(CNV_status %in% c("Gain", "Neutral"))
    colors <- cnv_colors_gain
  }

  # Skip if only one group
  if (length(unique(df_tumor$CNV_status)) < 2) {
    message(paste("Skipping — only one CNV group:", tumor, arm_col)); next
  }

  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(df_tumor,
              aes(x = CNV_status, y = .data[[ct_col]], fill = CNV_status)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
    stat_summary(
      fun.data = mean_se,
      geom = "errorbar",
      width = 0.2,
      linewidth = 0.8,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      fun = mean,
      geom = "point",
      size = 2,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format", size = 4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(tumor, "\n", ct_label, " by ", arm_name, " ", cnvtype),
      x     = paste0(arm_name, " SCNA Status"),
      y     = paste0(ct_label, " Score"),
      fill  = "SCNA Status"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 11))

  # Save
  filename <- paste0("boxplots_tier1/",
                     tumor, "_", arm_name, "_", cnvtype, "_",
                     gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", ct_label), ".pdf")
  ggsave(filename, plot = p, width = 4, height = 5)
  message(paste("Saved:", filename))
```

  if (length(unique(df_tumor$CNV_status)) < 2) {

    stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format", size = 4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cnv_colors_gain) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(tumor, "\n", ct_label, " by ", arm_name, " ", cnvtype),
      x     = paste0(arm_name, " SCNA Status"),
      y     = paste0(ct_label, " Score"),
      fill  = "SCNA Status"
    ) +
